description: Write one agent session's report on OpenVibe.Report (the Agent Streams plan, S3). POST /internal/session-reports stores the report of a Codes task, an Actor task, a desk session or a session on a person's own machine, and answers the report's page. The route is idempotent per (source, task ref): the same session's task always answers the same report. The caller is a first-party service - Codes, Actor or Live - with a service token that holds this capability for the audience openvibe.report; Network grants it to exactly those principals. The body names the person the session was theirs, and a service may only write a report for the person it acts for. Every text field passes the house redactor before anything is stored: the raw transcript and secrets never reach the report.
